label: Source-family certification review 001
method: Manual source-to-record review of two university-statement records selected from the non-ED awaiting-review lane. Certification is applied only when every gate passes; one reviewed record is kept not certified because a stored affected-community label is broader than the source text verified in this wave.
public_claim_limit: This artifact is internal source-to-record review. It must not be described as third-party review, external validation, endorsement, ranking, prevalence measurement, safety scoring, severity scoring, or legal finding.
